seoTitle: robots.txt Pattern to Regex Converter for Log Analysis
metaDescription: Convert robots.txt Allow and Disallow paths with * and $ into regular expressions for grep, awk and log tools. Free, in your browser.
intro: Turns robots.txt path patterns into regular expressions anchored at the start of the path.
why:
To count how often bots hit blocked areas in your logs, you need the same patterns as regular expressions. Converting by hand means escaping dots and question marks and mapping * to .* correctly.

Paste your rules and copy the regexes. The tool does not apply the longest-match logic between Allow and Disallow; that stays up to you or to the compliance log checker.
howTo: Paste rules with or without the Allow or Disallow prefix.
Copy the regex for each pattern.
Use it with grep -E, awk or a log platform.
Apply it to the path plus query string.

faq.a: Patterns match from the start of the path.
Yes, it becomes an end-of-string anchor.
No. The compliance log checker applies the full logic.
